agent-settings-many-description: Share with one or more people, teams, or departments.
agent-settings-audience-description: Anyone matching at least one selected person, team, or department can use this agent. The creator and Agent Admins always keep access.
agent-settings-audience-people-descripti: Selected people can use this agent.
agent-settings-audience-teams-descriptio: Members of selected teams can use this agent.
agent-settings-audience-departments-desc: Anyone assigned to a selected department can use this agent.
agent-edit-dialog-description: Change this agent's model, provider, and behavior. Changes apply to new messages immediately.
agent-edit-dialog-open-full-description: Edit every setting on the Agents page
provider-scope-personal-description: Only your requests can use these credentials. Secret values are never returned to the browser.
provider-scope-organization-description: Organization credentials are the fallback for users without a personal key and for background workflows.
provider-personal-key-required: API key is required for a personal provider
general-settings-description: Manage chat capabilities, organizational learning, evaluation, and summary models at runtime.
general-settings-api-url-description: Used by erxes tools to send requests to the GraphQL gateway.
general-settings-memory-description: Stores chat history and powers recent-history replay, semantic recall, and working memory. Turning this off disables those features for every agent; individual agents can still opt out.
general-settings-attachments-description: Let people add images, PDFs, spreadsheets, and documents to agent chat.
general-settings-storage-description: Uses the existing storage configured in Settings → File upload.
general-settings-storage-missing-descrip: Configure storage in Settings → File upload before enabling attachments.
general-settings-chat-description: Changes apply to new agent turns immediately, without restarting the plugin.
general-settings-background-removal-desc: Allow agents to run the memory-intensive background removal tool for workspace images.
general-settings-learning-description: Distill reusable, privacy-gated lessons from idle conversations and make approved lessons available to agents.
general-settings-learning-min-sources-de: Distinct people required before a lesson can be approved automatically.
general-settings-learning-min-confidence: Confidence required for automatic approval, from 0 to 1.
general-settings-learning-idle-descripti: Wait this long after activity before distilling a conversation.
general-settings-learning-decay-days-des: Start reducing confidence after this many days without reinforcement.
general-settings-learning-decay-factor-d: Multiplier applied during each daily decay, from 0 to 1.
general-settings-learning-archive-descri: Archive unpinned lessons when confidence falls below this value.
general-settings-learning-digest-entries: Maximum approved lessons added to one agent request.
general-settings-learning-digest-chars-d: Maximum characters of approved lessons added to one agent request.
general-settings-evaluation-description: Score agent responses and export traces and scores to this workspace's Langfuse project.
general-settings-evaluation-dsn-replace-: Enter a new DSN to replace the saved secret
general-settings-evaluation-dsn-descript: Write-only connection string. Saved credentials are never returned to the browser.
general-settings-evaluation-dsn-clear-de: The DSN is removed when these settings are saved.
general-settings-summarizer-description: Use an optional faster model for live activity, turn, and reasoning summaries. Leave both fields empty to use each agent's own model.
